Index.meta_title: AtendIA - Scheduling System for Your Business
Index.meta_description: Transform your salon, barbershop or clinic service into a professional experience. Online scheduling, organization and automation with artificial intelligence.

Hero.title: Transform your service into a more <important>professional, organized and intelligent</important> experience
Hero.description: We offer personalized scheduling systems for salons, barbershops, clinics and other appointment-based businesses. Your customers schedule from their phone, your calendar stays organized and you professionalize your service.

Features.section_title: Everything Your Business Needs to Professionalize Service
Features.section_description: Your customers can request appointments easily, your calendar stays centralized, your clients stay organized and you reduce manual tasks with automation.
Features.feature1_description: Your customers schedule from their phone anytime, anywhere. No calls, no waiting, no wasted time. Reduce no-shows with automatic reminders and keep your calendar full.
Features.feature2_description: All your appointments centralized in one place. View your week, block unavailable hours and manage your team intelligently.
Features.feature3_description: Complete registration for each client with appointment history, preferences and important information. Never lose data or forget client details again.
Features.feature4_description: Automatic confirmations, WhatsApp reminders, quick responses and smart workflows. Reduce manual work and focus on what really matters: your clients.
Features.feature5_description: Your system with your business visual identity. Colors, logo, layout and information adapted to convey professionalism and trust to your clients.
Features.feature6_description: Our team handles all configuration, updates and maintenance. You don't need to worry about anything technical — just use it and focus on your business.

Pricing.section_title: Choose the Ideal Plan for Your Business
Pricing.section_description: Plans starting at R$ 97/month with unconditional 30-day guarantee.

PricingPlans.profissional_plan_description: Scheduling + 1 Gemini AI in dashboard + CRM + automations
PricingPlans.premium_plan_description: 2 Gemini AIs + Meta API + campaigns + everything included

FAQ.question1: What do I receive when I subscribe?
FAQ.answer1: You receive a personalized scheduling system with your business identity, including a professional page, service registration, schedule organization, client registration and an admin panel. Depending on the plan, it also includes CRM, automations and artificial intelligence.
FAQ.answer2: No. Our team handles all configuration and customization. You just need to fill in your business details and start using. The system is intuitive and designed for people who don't understand technology.
FAQ.answer3: Your customers access a professional page with your business identity and can request appointments easily from their phone. Everything works like an app, without needing to download anything.
FAQ.answer4: The Essential plan already includes online scheduling, service and client registration. Professional adds CRM, automations, reminders and reports. Premium includes all that plus artificial intelligence, advanced automations and a complete admin panel.
FAQ.answer5: Yes. We offer an unconditional 30-day guarantee. If you're not satisfied, we refund 100% of the amount paid. No questions, no bureaucracy.
FAQ.answer6: Yes. You can upgrade your plan at any time. The price difference is proportional to the remaining time in your current cycle.
